extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Cigna plan available in Lee County has a $30 monthly premium, a $410 drug deductible and a $5700 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan costs and benefits before mentioning that not all plans are offered, which is compliant. The Scope of Appointment was collected and an appointment was scheduled within a short time frame.
composition.coaching_note: Grace did a good job by delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits. However, she could improve by providing a more detailed explanation of the Scope of Appointment, ensuring the customer fully understands the next steps.

crm_record.next_step: Follow up with Mrs. Dubois on the scheduled plan review.
